commit.message:
fix: eliminate Mermaid node-text clipping in the At a Glance diagram

- Restructured the At a Glance diagram from the individually-wired
  Input/Capability/Output edge model to the flat, unwired
  Starting Points -> Product -> Core Capabilities -> Outputs container
  chain (2 balanced Core Capabilities columns for the 7 real
  capabilities).
- The prior model's converging/crossing edges triggered a real, confirmed
  rendering inconsistency in GitHub's Mermaid renderer: the "Outputs and
  accessible content" container title rendered cut off ("Outputs and
  accessible c...") and the "Keyframe animation data" output node
  rendered cut off ("Keyframe an...") on the live page.
- No capability, input, or output was added, removed, or reworded --
  every one of the 6 Starting Points, 7 Core Capabilities, and 6 Outputs
  labels is byte-identical to the prior version, only the diagram's
  topology changed.

Verification: the corrected diagram was independently re-rendered against
a real Mermaid renderer before this push, confirming every label is now
fully visible with no clipping, truncation, or overlap.

Co-authored-by: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

repo.description: Aspose.3D FOSS for Python is a MIT-licensed, pure-Python library for working with 3D file formats. Install it with a single pip command and immediately start reading, constructing, and writing 3D scenes without installing any native runtime, external SDK, or third-party renderer.
